notes.title: Very Bad Dreams - enhanced version
notes.notes:
This new demo comes from the PS5 version, which has been updated throughout the year. It brings a lot of bug fixes and a better experience through a selection of levels of the full game Very Bad Dreams. 

You have access to 3 levels that, we hope, will hit you in the guts and make you want to try out the full game !

Life is a game, enjoy !

CRVR3D Team
